name: Seedream55ai
tagline: Create and edit AI images from text prompts with Seedream 5.5 in your browser
description:
Seedream55ai is a browser-based studio for making and reworking pictures with the Seedream 5.5 image model. Instead of installing software or wiring up a local GPU, you open https://seedream55ai.com/, type what you want to see, and get finished images back in a few moments.

What it does
- Text to image: describe a scene, a product shot, a poster layout or a character, and the model renders it at high resolution with careful handling of lighting, texture and composition.
- Image editing: upload a picture and ask for changes in plain language, such as swapping a background, changing colors, adding an object or restyling the whole frame, while keeping the parts you did not mention.
- Readable text in images: Seedream 5.5 is good at placing short headlines, labels and signage, which makes it useful for thumbnails, banners and mock packaging.
- Style range: photorealistic renders, illustration, 3D-looking scenes, anime-inspired art and flat graphic design can all come from the same prompt box.

Who it is for
Seedream55ai suits marketers who need fresh visuals for campaigns, ecommerce sellers who want clean product backgrounds, bloggers and YouTubers making cover art, and designers who want quick concept drafts before polishing work in their usual tools. Because everything runs in the browser, it works the same on a laptop, a work PC or a tablet.

How a typical session goes
Write a prompt, pick an aspect ratio, generate, then refine with a follow-up instruction instead of starting over. Results can be downloaded straight away, and your recent images stay in your history so you can return to an idea later.

Pricing
Credit packs from $2.99, no auto-renewal. You buy credits when you need them and spend them per generation, so there is no subscription to remember to cancel.

About the site
Seedream55ai is an independent website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by ByteDance. Questions, feedback and support requests go to support@seedream55ai.com.
